  title = {The API runs on the VM as a Compose stack behind nginx from Milestone 4},
  note = {\textbf{Revised on 2026-10-21}: the image size measured again with the interval boosters of \#158; the decision is unchanged.},
  date = {2026-10-20},
  milestone = {M4: Model Deployment},

  participants = {@lukas2510 decided (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/142}{issue \#142})},
  decision = {From M4 on, the API runs on the VM as a Docker Compose stack: the API image, with the serving runtime and the model bundle, behind nginx, the only published container, which refuses \texttt{/\allowbreak{}feedback} and \texttt{/\allowbreak{}metrics}.
Until CD exists, the image is built on a laptop and copied with \texttt{docker save | ssh docker load}.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item The course demo's recipe (\texttt{uv sync}, \texttt{dvc pull}, uvicorn under systemd, nginx): M5 replaces it with containers, so two deployments to build and document.
\item Building the image on the VM: needs the repository, DVC and a DagsHub token on a shared machine.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The report describes containers under M5 either way, so the demo's recipe builds something we plan to discard, while M5 adds CI/CD, the image scan and the hardening to this stack.
Measured locally, the image is 702 MB (NFR-04: 1 GB), and \texttt{/\allowbreak{}health} answers again 3 s after the API process is killed (NFR-05: 30 s).
nginx stays over Caddy and Traefik, whose main gain, automatic TLS, EDN-13 does not need.},

  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI laid out both options in the issue and recommended Compose, which @lukas2510 chose.
